name: Six Faces
tagline: An ultramarine nocturne built around a die that only lands on true numbers.
summary: Graded CC0 and NASA photographs turn the whole site into one saturated ultramarine, with a single sodium-amber light for what matters. The hero is the Honest Die, a CSS 3D cube you grab and throw: whichever real number lands face up, the photograph behind it develops into that number's scene. It presents Albretsen AS as effective and plain-spoken: live, building, paused and retired are all printed as clearly as the revenue.
voice: Brutal honesty, said calmly: numbers first, no rounding, no adjectives. "Toolrails has 4 connectors. It is not finished, and says so."
motion: Physical and then exact: things fly with inertia, then land square on a spring; photographs develop behind a sodium scan line; the theme turns the whole page like a cube face.
sound: Off by default; when turned on, one soft wooden knock each time the die lands.
mark: An isometric die seen from its corner, paper top and ultramarine sides, with one sodium pip for the one number that matters, beside an outlined Archivo wordmark.
